name: Bangor Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Bangor and Gwynedd
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Mondays and Thursdays.

name: Bangor Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Treborth with 40 plots and polytunnel
months: this garden provides growing space and runs Welsh language growing workshops.

name: Bangor Community Fridge

description: Located at Storiel museum and gallery
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food. Open Tuesday-Saturday.
